messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU Xid resets detected on cluster-prod-gpu-03. Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-runtime. Paging oncall-sRE. (#alerts/infra)

oncall-sRE: I'm on it — grabbing logs and metrics. Seeing lots of container restarts tied to GPU tasks. Starting timeline capture.

raj: Observed spike ~100 Xid 43/31 events in the last 60s across gpu-03. ECC corrected counters trending up. Possible hardware degradation or driver flapping.

jin: dmesg tail from gpu-03 (last 2m):
```
[ 1023.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID: 4821: GPU page fault on channel 0x1a
[ 1023.456800] NVRM: RmmioRead: invalid BAR access
[ 1023.458000] kernel: nvhost: NvHost: GPU reset (xid=43)
[ 1023.460100] containerd: container restart: sandboxed-infer-abc (exit code 137)
```

emily: Confirmed customer-facing 500s and increased tail latency. Killed inference workers auto-restarted but crash loops persist. Support reports enterprise-cust-17 seeing ~12% error rate.

ops-runner: I'm kicking the evacuation policy for cluster-prod-gpu-03 and rerouting traffic to cluster-prod-gpu-01/02. Applying temporary routing rule:
```bash
# route override for affected node pool
redwoodctl routes set --service inference-runtime --region us-east --avoid-nodepool cluster-prod-gpu-03 --priority 10
```

oncall-sRE: Doing immediate mitigations: cordon + drain non-critical pods from gpu-03. Keeping canary inference pods to observe behavior. Plan: cordon -> drain (graceful) -> reboot node if resets continue.
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-03
kubectl drain gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
```

raj: Does anyone recall a recent kernel or driver push to gpu-03? I don't see recent infra churn in deploy history for that pool. Last host image update was 4 days ago.

jin: Container logs show repeated CUDA fault at runtime start:
```
RuntimeError: CudaError: unknown error (cuCtxGetCurrent failed)
...
InferWorker.cpp:142 init_cuda() -> driver returned error: Xid 31
```

emily: Since this is causing customer impact, support-led please open a customer incident and notify SRE/CS about mitigation steps and expected ETA.

support-led: On it. Created INC-2026-112 for enterprise-cust-17 and notified their EM. Added note: currently failing requests routed to fallback region; some degradation remains.

ops-runner: Autoscaling: spinning up two extra nodes in Dedicated pool to absorb load — policy triggered: reserved-capacity-burst.

oncall-sRE: After drain, node still shows Xid events in kernel logs when attempting to restart GPU driver. Proceeding with host reboot (soft). If reboot doesn't clear Xid churn, we'll schedule replacement behind the pool. Triggering now.

oncall-sRE: Reboot initiated. ETA ~3m. Will monitor infra dashboards and error rates. :coffee:

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: oncall-sRE -> emily in 30 minutes. Please annotate runbook and current status.

emily: Acknowledged, I'll take second half. If reboot doesn't resolve, plan B is to cordon long-term and replace node (RAID vendor ticket) and increase retry budgets for customers.

raj: Action items for post-incident: capture full /var/log/kern.log, GPU ECC counters, nv-host driver logs, and collect coredumps from InferWorker. File a ticket with GPU vendor if Xid persists. Also run memtest on node before returning to pool.

support-led: Noted — updating customer with transient mitigation steps and that a potential node replacement may be required.

jin: After reboot, kernel shows no new Xid in the 2-minute window. Watching for recurrence. Container restarts dropped to baseline but we'll keep canaries for 15m.

emily: I'm taking the handoff early. Current status: node rebooted, traffic rerouted, error rate reduced from 12% -> 1.8%. We'll keep node out of rotation until vendor diagnostics finish. Logging next steps to incident tracker. :white_check_mark: 

oncall-sRE: Good job team. Adding tags: gpu-driver-reset, xid-spike, customer-impact. Postmortem owners: raj (root cause), jin (logs/telemetry), emily (mitigation & comms).

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated state. Continue monitoring; create postmortem within 72h. :memo:
